analysis:
All supplied changes are documentation only. No code, endpoint, key, attestation, authorization or encryption behavior changes, so no TB-002/TB-011 gate, App Attest policy or trust-level semantics are altered.

docs/design/glm53-flash-native.md (new, lines 1-131): a design for GLM-5.3-Flash. It states the work is not release-qualified and keeps glm5_next out of EngineV2SupportedModels (lines 16-17). It pins the official source and community artifact revisions by commit hash (lines 21, 29). It notes that header-only coverage is not payload hashing (lines 31-33). It requires cache identity binding to the authenticated scope and existing encrypted cache storage (lines 81-83). It forbids prompts, token IDs, media or tool arguments in telemetry (lines 122-123). Rollout stages are approval-gated. This is consistent with A-004, T-012, T-027 and T-041. A model-artifact supply-chain item is relevant when the adapter lands: the community Vontra weights and the raw template differ from the official source. The plan has payload hash and tensor validation gates, so this is future work to review, not a regression.

docs/developer/build.md (lines 47-73): adds GLM5Next build and parser notes, SSD test working-volume notes and MiMo scratch-directory reuse guidance. It tells readers not to patch build checkouts and to record test-binary identity before --skip-build. The scratch-directory reuse guidance at lines 68-73 is hygiene guidance, not a control change.

docs/developer/mimo-prompt-fixtures.md (lines 65-103): adds new tool-schema regression fixtures with a SHA-256 pin and test commands. They use metadata only, with no weights or credentials.

docs/developer/test.md: only metadata and a truncated patch excerpt were supplied. The unit 67373c0eff1153bd:0 has no body text. The head ranges 44-288 and 294-321 were not reviewed in full. A later pass should confirm those sections introduce no credential exposure, unsafe temp or working-volume paths for SSD cache tests, or claims of qualification.
